title: How is the relation graph laid out and drawn?
why: The tasks below need a fixed answer; a weaker agent should not have to choose a layout.

decision.rationale: The owner asked for a picture, so a table is not enough. heist serve loads no external assets, which rules out a graph library. Blocking relations cannot form a cycle, so tickets can be placed in columns by their longest chain of blockers; that reads as an order and is identical on every open. Codex chose a table for the Dependencies tab for accessibility; that tab stays, and the graph is an additional tab.
